jobs.occupation: Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - External API Development for New Chemical Entities (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - External API Development for New Chemical Entities

You are an experienced synthetic and process chemist with the ambition to shape the chemical foundation of our R&D pipeline for new chemical entities (NCEs) by designing, developing, and enabling synthetic routes that evolve into robust API manufacturing processes in partnership with our external CDMO network.

In this Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) position within global CMC teams, you define and drive the DS strategy and are accountable for the DS contribution to the overall CMC package. Serving as the central interface between internal stakeholders and external partners, you lead chemical process development and API supply activities, enabling phase-appropriate, scalable, and sustainable manufacturing processes that ensure timely API delivery, robust product quality, and cost efficiency.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Provide scientific leadership for the design, assessment, and optimization of synthetic routes for new APIs in preclinical and clinical phases, with a focus on speed, quality, cost, sustainability, and process understanding
- Represent Drug Substance (DS) in global CMC development project teams and contribute to key scientific, strategic, and portfolio decisions, while ensuring a coherent two-way flow of strategy, decisions, risks, and progress between the internal global CMC team and external CDMO activities
- Guide and challenge route design and synthetic methodology choices at external CDMOs, translating SAR-driven chemistry into scalable routes for preclinical and clinical supply and future production in alignment with the internal DS development strategy
- Oversee external API campaigns for toxicology studies and clinical trials, including planning, risk assessment, supply-demand alignment, and budget oversight
- Steer process transfers between external partners and into internal development or external manufacturing, ensuring knowledge continuity and phase-appropriate documentation
- Contribute to robust, phase-appropriate control strategies. Co-author and review the Drug Substance sections of regulatory filings (IND/IMPD and briefing documents) and support responses to health authority questions
- Provide CMC DS assessments for in-licensing opportunities
- Provide chemical expertise and pragmatic troubleshooting across the internal and external manufacturing network. Actively contribute to the chemistry community by sharing knowledge and driving innovation across organizational boundaries

WHO YOU ARE

- Ph.D. in Chemistry or a related science, with extensive experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including an understanding of GLP/GMP and regulatory expectations
- Strong background in synthetic chemistry, with an excellent understanding of reagents, methodologies, and reaction mechanisms, plus a solid grasp of analytical techniques
- Experience in the CMC development of peptides is a plus
- Experience in steering external partners (CROs/CDMOs) or working across an external manufacturing network is a clear advantage
- Proven ability to represent chemistry and Drug Substance in interdisciplinary CMC or project teams and to act as an accountable interface between the internal organization and external partners
- A strategic thinker with the ability to think innovatively, develop and analyze multiple solutions to complex chemistry problems, and challenge the status quo
- Strong communication and project management skills across scientific disciplines, cultures, and organizational boundaries, combined with assertiveness, service orientation, and enjoyment of cross-functional teamwork
- Fluency in English (negotiation level), both written and spoken; German is an asset and willingness to learn German is required

WHAT WE OFFER

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.
- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

Be You. Be Bayer.

This is your opportunity to tackle the world’s biggest challenges with us: Maintaining our health, feeding growing populations and slowing the rate of climate change. You have a voice, ideas and perspectives and we want to hear them. Because our success begins with you. Be part of something big. Be Bayer.

jobs.occupation: Junior Martech Specialist Mobile Apps - English Speaking (m/w/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
Über UnsCustomlytics is the leading app marketing consultancy in the DACH region. Our international team of professionals from more than 10 nationalities helps apps succeed and drives the professionalization of the app industry by working with all relevant app companies in the market. Can you imagine a world without apps? Neither can we!

As a Junior MarTech Specialist (Mobile App focus), you will support the setup, maintenance, and monitoring of clients’ mobile app marketing and tracking systems. You will work closely with team members to ensure Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as Adjust and AppsFlyer are correctly configured and functioning properly.

You will be onboarded into mobile attribution and tracking systems, quickly gaining hands-on experience with troubleshooting issues and helping ensure that tracking, event collection, and campaign data are correctly recorded across advertising platforms. You will also help maintain mobile app data feeds and marketing datasets, ensuring data quality and supporting updates under guidance from senior colleagues.

In addition, you will contribute to reporting and dashboard creation by preparing data and supporting the build of simple visualizations that help teams understand campaign performance and user acquisition. You will support internal teams and clients such as Rewe, Audible, and Telekom by assisting in maintaining reliable tracking setups and helping resolve basic data or integration issues.
Deine Aufgaben
• Support the setup and maintenance of Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as Adjust and AppsFlyer, helping ensure accurate tracking and attribution functionality.
• Assist in identifying and troubleshooting basic tracking or event issues in mobile app campaigns.
• Help maintain and update clients’ product feeds and marketing datasets, ensuring data is correctly structured and validated.
• Support the connection of marketing tools and data sources to improve visibility of campaign performance. building and updating dashboards and visualizations in tools such as Clarisights, Adverity, and Google Sheets.
• Work with senior team members and developers to understand technical requirements and support implementation tasks.
• Monitor tracking setups and reporting flows to help ensure data accuracy and reliability.

You don’t have experience in all those tasks? No worries! We will be happy to onboard you on all of our processes and provide you with the opportunity to quickly learn and experience Martech hands on!

Dein Profil
• Background: Background in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related discipline, with an interest in marketing data, tracking systems, and campaign attribution.
• Product Feeds: Basic understanding of product feed structures; experience with tools like ProductsUp is a plus.
• Mobile Measurement Partners: Introductory knowledge of MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer); willingness to learn troubleshooting and tracking fundamentals.
• Advertising Platforms: Familiarity with platforms such as Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads, or TikTok (hands-on experience is a plus).
• Data & Reporting: experience working with Excel or Google Sheets; understanding of simple data handling and reporting.
• Automation & AI Tools: Interest in tools such as ChatGPT, Make.com, or Google Sheets automation; no advanced experience required.
• Analytical Mindset : Curious and detail-oriented, with a willingness to learn how data supports marketing decisions.
• Communication & Collaboration: Able to communicate clearly, ask questions, and work effectively within a team.
• Working Style: Structured, proactive, and eager to develop technical and analytical skills.
• Languages : Fluent in English (spoken and written); German is a plus but not required.

Dein Extra
• Your Growth & Development: Access to certifications, 360° feedback, and salary progression. Real opportunities to grow together with your team and the company.
• Remote Work: Work remotely for up to 90 days per year; anywhere in Germany or internationally.
• Office Vibes in Friedrichshain: Snacks, drinks, height-adjustable desks, and focus rooms for deep, concentrated work.
• Germany Ticket: We cover most of your public transport costs: good for the planet and your wallet.
• Top-Notch Equipment: MacBook, noise-cancelling headphones, and all the tools you need to succeed.
• Core Working Hours: Making collaboration easy and your schedule steady.
• Corporate Benefits: Exclusive deals with popular online brands.
• Support for Parents: Extra support for parents with preschool-aged children.
• Team Culture & Events: From monthly activities to our big annual meetup in Berlin, we create space to celebrate, connect, and grow as a team.
• German Language Courses : We support you with professional online German classes.
• Referral Bonus: Whether new teammates or new clients, your recommendations pay off.

We're committed to diversity and equal opportunity for all, welcoming individuals of any gender, age, origin, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. If you're creative, problem-solving, and passionate about app marketing, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and be yourself in an atmosphere where diversity is celebrated and embraced.

* Commitment to delivering high customer satisfaction, exceptional service quality, and sustainable business growth

* Support and promotion of a collaborative learning culture and knowledge sharing environment
* Customer-centric service excellence and responsiveness to evolving market requirements
* Ownership and accountability for operational effectiveness and business success

* Strong commitment to professional development, continuous learning, and effective communication
* Rapid comprehension of complex topics and proficiency in utilizing IT tools, including SAP and MS Office

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Negotiation Lead in the Corporate Strategic Procurement Department at Siemens Energy, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing high-stakes negotiation strategies that drive value for the company. You will be the go-to expert for complex negotiations, providing both hands-on and strategic guidance to transform settings and outcomes. Each day, you will engage in impactful negotiations, optimize supplier agreements, and enhance procurement processes. Your expertise will directly influence our corporate procurement strategies, contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of reimagining energy for a sustainable world. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and execute negotiation strategies for complex supplier negotiations, driving cost optimization, cost recovery, risk mitigation, and improved commercial terms
* Lead critical supplier negotiations and provide strategic advice to Procurement leaders on objectives, trade-offs, escalation strategies, and outcomes
* Further develop the negotiation competence hub by establishing consistent negotiation standards, methodologies, and best practices
* Build negotiation capabilities across the organization through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing
* Translate negotiation outcomes and lessons learned into enhanced commodity, supplier, and procurement strategies
* Drive digital innovation and continuous improvement across the negotiation lifecycle, fostering a strong negotiation mindset and culture of excellence

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* Extensive professional experience in strategic procurement and/or commercial negotiations, with a proven track record in complex, high-stakes environments
* Deep knowledge of negotiation principles and advanced methodologies, combined with strong commercial acumen and excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills.
* Outstanding communication, influencing, and advisory skills, with the ability to effectively challenge and engage senior stakeholders.
* Strong coaching and collaboration skills, with proven ability to build effective cross-functional and international networks and manage multiple priorities.
* Passion for digitalization and innovation, with experience in digital procurement and negotiation tools; fluency in English, with additional languages as an advantage.

About the Team

Our global Special Projects and Transformation team is part of Siemens Energy’s Corporate Commodity  Management organization. We partner with Procurement teams and businesses worldwide to deliver strategic  initiatives, strengthen capabilities, and transform how Procurement creates value.  You will join a collaborative and forward - looking team where diverse perspectives, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

The MPG consists of three sections: the Biology and Medicine Section, the Chemistry, Physics and Technology Section and the Human Sciences Section. Each section has a Scientific Scouting Officer who supports the respective section and its institutes in identifying the next generation of leading researchers.

For the Human Sciences Section, the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG are now seeking a:

80% part‑time initially, with a potential full‑time transition effective 1 January 2029

(Reference Number 63/26)
